# comment parent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:commentParent`](gmeow-commentParent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/commentParent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The annotation or comment that this comment replies to. Every [`Comment`](../classes/gmeow-Comment.md) has exactly one [`commentParent`](gmeow-commentParent.md). The range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (encompassing [`Annotation`](../classes/gmeow-Annotation.md) and [`Comment`](../classes/gmeow-Comment.md)) so that a comment may reply to any annotatable entity without identity clash.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Comment`](../classes/gmeow-Comment.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:commentParent`](gmeow-commentParent.md) from [`gmeow:Comment`](../classes/gmeow-Comment.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle
# --- A comment threading under the paper (a Comment IS a Note).
ex:comment a gmeow:Comment ;
    gmeow:noteAuthor    ex:dana ;
    gmeow:noteContent   "Does this hold for very long sequences?" ;
    gmeow:commentParent ex:paper .
```
